records.relation: holds its gold reserves in custody
records.detail: Angola's central bank keeps its gold itself: at the end of 2017 the Banco Nacional de Angola had 602,000 troy ounces, or 18,700 kilograms, in its own safekeeping, worth more than 128 billion kwanzas, according to the bank's own 2017 annual report and accounts as read by the Lusa news agency. The report names no outside bank or vault operator.
records.source_title: Reservas de ouro a guarda do BNA aumentaram 14 por cento em 2017 (VerAngola / Lusa, 25 October 2018, reporting the BNA relatorio e contas de 2017)
records.quote: terá à sua guarda quase 19 toneladas de ouro ... mais de 602.000 onças troy (18.700 quilogramas)

confirmed_blank.document: Banque centrale du Luxembourg, Rapport annuel 2025 (BCL_RAPPORT_ANNUEL_2025_FR.pdf, bcl.lu), full PDF downloaded and searched
confirmed_blank.sections_read: NOTE 3 - AVOIRS ET CREANCES EN OR (the gold note, in full); the accounting policy 'Actifs et passifs en or et en devises'; and the reserve-management sections 'Portefeuille de reserves en devises' and 'Services de gestion des reserves'

confirmed_blank.document: National Bank of Ethiopia, Annual Financial Statements for the year ended 30 June 2020 (Annual-Financial-Statetments-2020.pdf, nbe.gov.et), full PDF downloaded and searched
confirmed_blank.sections_read: Accounting policy 3(s) 'Gold' and Note 10 'Gold', parts (a) Monetary gold and (b) Gold commodity
confirmed_blank.finding: The only institution named holds the gold as an interest-bearing time deposit, not as stored metal: the Bank's monetary gold is 'gold deposits' and 'time deposits' at Commerzbank, capped at 8,000 ounces. Under the rule that gold placed for yield is not custody, this names no custodian. Nothing in the statements says where any metal physically sits.
confirmed_blank.quote: Monetary gold refers to gold that is held in foreign financial institutions to enable the bank to build an international reserve. NBE invests a maximum of 8,000 ounces of gold in the form of time deposits at Commerz Bank. ... The Bank holds gold deposits at Commerz Bank to enable the bank to build an international reserve. confirmed_blank.document: Central Bank of Solomon Islands Annual Report 2024 (CBSI-Annual-Report-2024.pdf, cbsi.com.sb), read in three passes covering all 311,960 characters
confirmed_blank.sections_read: Chapter 4 international reserves and 'Gold Investment Policy'; the Middle Office counterparty section; Note 5 'Gold' and Note 2(m) 'Gold revaluation reserve' in the notes to the financial statements
confirmed_blank.finding: The Bank sold its gold bullion and now trades only unallocated gold, so there is no physical metal to hold: Note 5 carries SBD 44,364 thousand of unallocated gold at fair value at end-2024. No custodian, depository or vault is named. The counterparties named in the reserve-management text (BRED Banque, Paris; Crown Agents Investment Management, London) are not said to hold gold.
confirmed_blank.quote: Note 5: Unallocated gold at fair value 44,364 ... 'The balance represents the Banks holding of gold investment at year end.' Note 2(m): gold is classified at fair value through profit or loss, reflecting active trading in unallocated gold over the last three years after the Bank sold its gold bullion.

confirmed_blank.sections_read: Accounting policy 'a) Gold' and Note 11 'Gold and silver assets' (with Note 11.1)
confirmed_blank.finding: Note 11 gives gold at fair value of MVR 29,132,185 (2012: MVR 39,990,110) and silver at cost of MVR 71,172, then one sentence of valuation policy. No bank, vault, city or custodian is named in the note or the policy.
confirmed_blank.quote: The Authority holds gold as part of its reserves. Gold is fair valued and the gains or losses are recognised in the income statement.

confirmed_blank.document: New Vision (Uganda), 'BoU to secure global custodian for gold reserves' (newvision.co.ug, April 2026), fetched and read in full
confirmed_blank.sections_read: The whole article, including Governor Michael Atingi-Ego's remarks on custody and the refinery contracts
confirmed_blank.finding: The Bank of Uganda has no custodian yet: the Governor says the Bank plans to appoint one. The article names the two licensed refineries it buys through, EuroGold Refinery Ltd and Feldstein Trading Limited, but does not say either holds the metal, and it names no vault for the gold the Bank has already bought. Its reference to the Bank of England is a general statement about the industry, not about Uganda. The Auditor General's Report 2024 link on bou.or.ug returned a 7.6 kB non-PDF page, so the Bank's own accounts were not reached.
confirmed_blank.quote: secure an international custodian to hold Uganda's gold reserves (Governor Michael Atingi-Ego); 'The gold suppliers will be taking the gold to these refineries, where the BOU will be meeting them to buy.'

searched_no_result.note: Two searches for the Central Bank of Cyprus Annual Report and its 'Gold and gold receivables' note returned only Cyprus Mail and CBN balance-sheet news items and other banks' accounts; no CBC annual-report PDF URL surfaced, so nothing was read. Not a close.

Two searches for Banco Central del Ecuador estados financieros / notas 'oro monetario' returned Ecuadorian commercial banks, press pieces on gold sales and Goldman Sachs swaps, and the Banco Central de Chile statements; no BCE financial-statements PDF surfaced. Not a close.

Two searches for National Bank of the Republic of Belarus annual report / 'monetary gold' note returned only reserve-level news agency items (Interfax, Pozirk, regional government sites) and Belarusian commercial banks' IFRS accounts; no NBRB annual-report PDF surfaced. Not a close.

Search for National Bank of Tajikistan annual report / 'monetary gold' note returned Tajik commercial banks (Amonatbonk, Spitamenbank, Tawhidbank) and Asia-Plus reserve-level news; no NBT financial statements surfaced. Not a close.

Search surfaced several Banco Central de Costa Rica estados financieros PDFs on bccr.fi.cr, but every URL (efa-auditados-2025.pdf and efa-bccr-diciembre-2021-2020.pdf) returned HTTP 404 with an 87 kB error page to plain curl, so no note was read. Host needs a hand check.

Searches returned only Bank of Tanzania monthly 'Statements of Financial Position' PDFs plus one 'Financial Statements' path that 404s to curl; the document fetched at that path is an economic bulletin whose only gold reference is Table A1.9 mineral recoveries from the Ministry of Minerals. The Bank's audited statements with notes were not reached. Not a close.

Search for Banco de Cabo Verde relatorio anual / nota 'ouro' returned Angolan and Cape Verdean commercial banks and Forbes Africa Lusofona pieces on the BCV selling half its gold; no BCV financial statements surfaced. Not a close.

Search surfaced a Central Bank of Eswatini 'Annual Integrated Report 2024-25' PDF mirrored on independentnews.co.sz, but the download returned a 20 kB non-PDF page. Not a close; the report exists and needs a hand check.

leads_not_opened.lead: The primary document behind the filed Angola record is the BNA's own Relatorio e Contas 2017, which Lusa read; getting that PDF from bna.ao would upgrade the record from a press report to the bank's own accounts and may name a vault.

Bank of Uganda Auditor General's Report 2024 is published on bou.or.ug but the PDF link served a 7.6 kB page to curl: https://www.bou.or.ug/bouwebsite/bouwebsitecontent/publications/Annual_Reports/All/Auditor-Generals-Report-2024-30-Sept-1646-hrs-Compressed.pdf . Once BoU appoints the custodian the Governor describes, the appointment itself becomes a filable record.
Central Bank of Eswatini Annual Integrated Report 2024-25 exists; try centralbank.org.sz directly rather than the newspaper mirror.

bankofbotswana.bw served a 12 kB HTML page instead of Annual Report 2025 on the /sites/default/files/publications/ path while the 2024 report on the /news-files/ path downloaded normally; the 2025 report may carry a gold line the 2024 statements lack.
Only the 2020 statements were available; a later National Bank of Ethiopia year may move monetary gold out of Commerzbank time deposits into stored metal, which would be filable.

Only the 2013 Maldives Monetary Authority report was reachable (via a news archive mirror); mma.gov.mv publishes monthly balance sheets and later annual reports whose gold note may have been expanded.

Banco Central de Costa Rica estados financieros auditados PDFs are indexed under bccr.fi.cr/content/dam/bccr/transparencia-institutional/transparencia-doc-estados-financieros/ but 404 to automation; a hand check of the 2025 audited statements is the next step.
